title: AgentV RuntimeExtension manifest v1.0.0
description: Structural contract for Control Plane extension manifests. SRI proves bytes; ONLY a signature verified against the publisher trust root (server-side /api/v1/extensions/verify-publisher) grants trust, and the BACKEND's tier classification overrides any self-declared value. Semantic validation (api_version compatibility, capability whitelist, signature presence) is enforced by agentv_runtime.extension_contract.RuntimeExtension.validate.

api_version.description: Contract version targeted. Host enforces SemVer major/minor compatibility against EXTENSION_CONTRACT_VERSION.

capabilities.description: Must be a subset of KNOWN_CAPABILITIES; unknown capabilities are contract violations.

remote_entry.description: ESM entry URL for remote micro-frontend mounting.

sri_hash.description: SHA3-256 digest of the ESM bundle. Integrity only — never sufficient for trust alone.

publisher.description: Signing identity resolved via the trust root. REQUIRED when signed.

signature.description: Hex Ed25519 signature over canonical manifest bytes (every field EXCEPT signature). REQUIRED when signed.
